_comment: Repo-tracked CURATED catalog for Higgs Audio v3 narration voices — the Higgs counterpart of orpheus-models.json, and deliberately NOT the same shape where the two engines differ. Orpheus's catalog OVERLAYS a per-machine runtime install manifest because Orpheus voices are folder-discovered. Higgs has no folder discovery: a Higgs voice is a row in THIS FILE, so there is no runtime manifest and no reconcile fallback — a voice that is not listed here does not exist, and higgs-models.ts refuses it BY NAME rather than falling through to the served model's own speaker (which measures at 12% of the narrator's ECAPA ceiling: a DIFFERENT person, not a weak clone). Every number in backends.served is MEASURED — provenance in E:\training\_campaigns\2026-09-01-cod-full-rebuild\higgs\HIGGS_V3_LEVERS.md — or is an explicitly-marked placeholder that the loader REFUSES to render with.
_wireFormatComment: THIS FILE IS NOT THE WIRE FORMAT. narrator reads a VOICE DOCUMENT whose path arrives in NARRATOR_HIGGS_VOICES (see python/narrator/engine/higgs/config.py load_voices): `{ "<voiceId>": { "clips": [{path, transcript, seconds}], "scene"?, "adapterDir"?, "allowedControls"?, "maxReferenceSeconds"? } }`. In THAT format a Higgs voice is ALWAYS clips, and a fine-tune is an `checkpointDir` riding on the same object — there is no separate checkpoint kind. This catalog keeps an explicit `kind` anyway, because `kind` is what selects BOOKFORGE'S OWN RULES (above all: maxChars is REQUIRED and measured for an adapter, and may be the engine placeholder for a zero-shot voice) and because a picker has to tell a person which of the two they are choosing. `higgsVoicesDocument()` in higgs-models.ts translates one into the other; it is the only place the two shapes meet.
_licenseComment: Higgs Audio v3 (bosonai/higgs-audio-v3-tts-4b) ships under the Boson Higgs TTS 3 RESEARCH AND NON-COMMERCIAL license, and a fine-tune of those weights INHERITS it. That is why every entry carries an explicit `license` and `commercialUse: false`: this engine is enabled for Owen's personal evaluation and cannot ship in a commercial BookForge build without a separate licence from Boson AI. Higgs Audio v2 is the trainable-and-shippable family (Community licence: attribution plus 'Higgs Audio 2' in any fine-tune's name) and is NOT in this catalog — Owen dropped v2 on 2026-09-04 ('basically just Orpheus and we know Orpheus better').
_checkpointFilesComment: THE REQUIRED FILES OF A kind:checkpoint VOICE LIVE IN ITS checkpointDir, not in this catalog, and one of them is easy to lose: generation_config.json. vllm-omni serve resolves sampling FROM THE MODEL DIRECTORY (--generation-config defaults to auto), so that file IS the temperature/top_p/top_k every request is answered at; a merged dir without it falls through to the bare SamplingParams() in vllm_omni entrypoints/openai/stage_params.py — top_p 1.0, top_k DISABLED — which samples the untruncated 1026-way codebook tail and derails prompts over ~600 chars into babble (measured 2026-09-05). OpenAICreateSpeechRequest carries no sampling fields, so nothing per-request can correct it. PROVENANCE: bosonai/higgs-audio-v3-tts-4b ships NO generation_config.json (verified across the whole WSL HF cache and the Mac base snapshot) — the MERGE writes one into every merged dir from a recorded runs/<run>/generation_config.override.json whose values are vllm-omni own deploy/higgs_multimodal_qwen3.yaml stage-0 default_sampling_params ({temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 50, repetition_penalty 1.0}), recording the source in merge_manifest.json beside the weights. So a checkpointDir must carry: the weights, config.json, tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json, chat_template.jinja AND generation_config.json. BookForge does NOT check this — the directory is inside WSL (or on the Mac) and this process cannot see it; narrator refuses BY NAME at load (v3_served.require_generation_config, reached through checkpoint_serve_target) on absence, unparseable JSON, or a file carrying none of temperature/top_p/top_k. On the Mac that file is narrator OWN sampling too: mlx-audio 0.4.8 does not read it and its Model.generate defaults top_p/top_k to None. See docs/HIGGS_ENGINE.md and python/narrator/engine/PORT_NOTES.md 12.8d + 13.11.
_referenceComment: EXACTLY ONE REFERENCE CLIP PER VOICE, 30 s of audio at the very most. vllm-omni refuses multi-shot cloning, so 'two clips' means ONE pre-joined wav (clips joined by 0.35 s of silence) whose transcript is the transcripts joined in the same order — the joining happens when the voice is STAGED, never at render time, and this catalog stores the joined result. Every clip must declare its `seconds`: narrator's v3_served.reference_seconds refuses a clip without one rather than probing the file, so a missing duration is a render that dies after the server has already spent five minutes coming up. Measured: no reference 0.093 speaker cosine, one clip 0.680, two joined 0.692, against a 0.766 narrator self-ceiling — and same-book-vs-cross-book is worth +0.076 where the second clip is worth only +0.012, so a reference set must come from ONE book.

serving._comment: The shared v3 serving stack, selected by a model's engineVersion. A model entry may declare its own `serving` block, used INSTEAD of this one (never field-merged) so a voice has exactly one serving answer. narrator INVOKES the operator's launch script rather than writing its own — the CUDA_HOME/FlashInfer workarounds live there and a second copy would drift — so `launchScript` is what NARRATOR_HIGGS3_SERVE_SCRIPT points at.
serving._coldStartNote: 297 s from launch to /health answering, MEASURED on narrator's own GPU smoke (2026-09-04) — not the ~55 s the first audition reported, which was a warm cache. narrator's READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is 300, i.e. the measurement sits three seconds under the limit. Anything in BookForge that decides a Higgs job is dead must therefore allow AT LEAST five minutes before the first audio. Checked against the two that could: WORKER_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS is 10 minutes and WORKER_PROGRESS_TIMEOUT_MS is 12 (parallel-tts-bridge.ts), so both already clear it — but they clear it by minutes, not by an order of magnitude, and anyone tightening them must re-read this line. The server also preallocates to its utilization target (0.60 of 24 GB), so it OWNS the GPU while it is up.
serving._flashInferNote: FlashInfer is unavailable on sm_86 with torch 2.13+cu130 — it JIT-builds its attention kernels with nvcc and its bundled CCCL headers reject the CUDA 13 nvcc from the pip wheel — so the launch pins VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0, VLLM_DISABLE_FLASHINFER_PREFILL=1 and --attention-backend FLASH_ATTN. Speed only; the flashinfer-jit-cache cu130/sm_86 wheel from https://flashinfer.ai/whl/cu130/torch2.13/ is the route if v3 speed ever matters.

patches.why: vLLM 0.28's blanket negative-token-id rejection fires on vllm-omni's AUDIO_PLACEHOLDER_ID (-100), which the clone path deliberately emits for the talker to substitute reference embeddings at prefill. Without the patch EVERY clone request is HTTP 400 'Token id -100 is out of vocabulary' — which is what made cloning look broken in the first audition.

Upstream substitutes every out-of-range code with 0 and then trims exactly ONE frame. Both halves are wrong: 0 is a VALID codec code, so the substitution CONVERTS the ramp-down BOC/EOC sentinels into real sound rather than neutralising them; and the sentinels smear across the last Q-1 = 7 frames (codebook c is delayed by c positions), so one frame leaves ~240 ms of audible garbage at the end of every chunk — Owen heard it as 'a stray syllable or sound after each sentence'. The patch decides by TOKEN IDENTITY instead: a frame is kept iff all 8 codebooks are in [0, 1023], nothing out of range ever reaches the codec, and there is no substitution and no positional trim left. The sync path gets the full filter; the streaming path gets the trailing run only, because Stage 1 trims left_context/right_holdback BY FRAME COUNT and dropping a leading or interior frame there would desync those trims and cut real speech. IT IS SERVER-SIDE: a patched server returns an already-clean tail and THE CLIENT MUST NOT TRIM AGAIN — what is left is a hard sample boundary, which is the assembler's 10/25 ms fade job. SUPERSEDES patch_tail_trim.py (retired 2026-09-05), which walked backwards from the end while frames were bad — positional reasoning that kept the 0-substitution for every sentinel outside the trailing run.
patches._markerNote: The marker is `_filter_sentinel_frames` and NOT `_trim_trailing_sentinel_frames`: this patch writes BOTH helpers (the trailing-run one is what the streaming path calls), and the retired patch_tail_trim.py wrote the trailing-run one too — so grepping for that would certify a band-aided file as patched. `absentMarker` is the other half of the proof and is asserted to be ABSENT: `[:, :-1]` is upstream's one-frame trim, which occurs twice in the pristine file and zero times after this patch (measured on the certifying box, vllm-omni 0.28.0, 2026-09-05). Present marker + absent trim is exactly 'the token-identity filter is in and no trim code remains', which is the half of the patch's proof that can be checked statically.
patches._certifiedShaNote: The stage processor this patch produces, on vllm-omni 0.28.0, is sha256 0b36f6507dd11653253bbebb278c3657e5d17a2a52f78018cd0bddd45a7ac210 (pristine: 376ca5647773cb191634b266b03bfefe490c080ef9f75aed045f1f31c9a19fb4), and the repo's electron/scripts/higgs/patch_sentinel_filter.py reproduces it byte for byte from the pristine file — verified 2026-09-05. THAT SHA IS PART OF A CERTIFICATE: a certificate binds (checkpoint dir, stage-processor sha, max_chars) together, so a change to this patch is a new server build that re-certifies rather than inheriting a published cap. See docs/HIGGS_ENGINE.md.

serving._voiceSwitchNote: A VOICE SWITCH IS A SERVER RESTART, and that is not a tuning choice — it is the only thing vllm-omni supports. It cannot load a LoRA at runtime: there are no adapter flags on `vllm-omni serve`, and the higgs_audio_v3 talker class does not implement SupportsLoRA. So every Higgs voice ships as a MERGED CHECKPOINT DIRECTORY (~8.5 GB) and the server is started ON that directory. Switching voice costs a restart: ~55 s warm (page cache hot) to ~300 s cold, against the 300 s readyTimeoutSeconds. A book renders in ONE voice, so this is paid once per job and never per chunk — but anything that imagined mixing voices within a render, or a cheap per-request voice cast, cannot be built on this stack.

models.label: Higgs v3 built-in voice (no reference)

served._maxCharsNote: 600 is the ZERO-SHOT figure and it is measured, not guessed: coverage by faster-whisper/difflib alignment is 1.000 at 213/440/504 chars and holds through 600, while 898 chars fails REPRODUCIBLY (coverage 0.86 and 0.78 on two seeds; tail coverage 0.314 and 0.000 — it drops the end of the paragraph). A reference clip does NOT fix it; it is a v3 model property that v2 does not have. DURATION RATIO IS NOT A COVERAGE PROXY: at temperature 0.7 the 898-char chunk produced ratio 0.99 while actually delivering coverage 0.778 with a 26% insert rate — it dropped text and padded the duration with hallucinated words, and any cap built on duration alone would have passed it. THIS NUMBER IS VALID ONLY FOR ZERO-SHOT and must never be copied onto an adapter voice; see the deathstalker entry.
served._edgeFadeNote: WHO APPLIES THIS: narrator's assembler, and as of narrator 4854aae4 it DOES — assemble/engine_profiles.py declares higgs-v3 as pads=false with 10/25 ms fades, assemble/edges.py applies them as RAISED-COSINE windows (zero slope at both ends, so the join has no discontinuity in the first derivative either), and _plan_unpadded realizes the manifest gapBefore/gapAfter as generated silence through one FLAC writer so the concat stays homogeneous. Prep writes the gaps.json sidecar these read, and session_v1 REFUSES a pads=false session without it. An earlier draft of parallel-tts-bridge.ts justified routing Higgs assembly to narrator by claiming narrator already read this field when neither side did; it does now, and the number is here because the catalog is where per-voice tuning lives. WHY THE FADE IS NEEDED AT ALL: Higgs emits NO lead/trail silence of its own — unlike Orpheus, which bakes pads into each chunk FLAC — and the patched server already trims its own sentinel tail, so what reaches the assembler ends at a hard sample boundary: a step discontinuity, i.e. a click. 25 ms out / 10 ms in removes it, taking a chunk edge from about -30 dB to -45..-48 dB. Applied at ASSEMBLY and never baked into the per-chunk wav, so the raw model output stays inspectable. This is also why the manifest gapBefore/gapAfter are LIVE for Higgs where they are inert for Orpheus.
served._samplingNote: The server's OWN shipped defaults (vllm_omni/deploy/higgs_multimodal_qwen3.yaml, stage 0 default_sampling_params), and the delivered render sends NO extra_params at all so they apply verbatim. Written down here anyway so the value that renders is stated rather than inherited invisibly from a yaml inside site-packages. TWO TRAPS: (1) temperature/top_p/top_k are NOT fields of OpenAICreateSpeechRequest — sent at the request top level pydantic DROPS them silently and the render runs at 1.0/0.95/50 regardless, which is exactly how the first audition reported 0.3 while running at 1.0; they must ride inside `extra_params`. (2) Deviations were measured (temp 0.3/0.7/1.0 at top_p 0.95 gave cosine 0.653/0.675/0.642 at 368 chars) and the spread is INSIDE single-seed noise — two seeds of the same setting differ by 0.04 — so one seed per cell cannot rank them and none beat the default enough to leave it.
served._allowedControlsNote: EMPTY ON PURPOSE, and it is a safety rule rather than a preference. An inline control token that is NOT in get_added_vocab() is split into 7-10 ordinary text pieces and READ ALOUD, which derails generation into a degenerate loop: ASR coverage 0.000, pitch std collapsing to 0.28 st, speaker cosine 0.05. A typo is not ignored — it destroys the render. v3 also has NO scene-description mechanism (<|scene_desc_start|> is a v2 chat role, absent from v3's vocabulary) and no `neutral`/`calm` emotion. At default sampling no control token beat plain text on speaker cosine, and the one candidate (<|prosody:long_pause|>) did not change measured pause density. The delivered render uses none. An empty allowlist means no engine ever has to get the validation right.

models.note: The model's own voice with no reference audio at all. MEASURED at ECAPA speaker cosine 0.0929 against the deathstalker narrator — 12% of that narrator's own 0.7656 self-consistency ceiling — i.e. it is a DIFFERENT SPEAKER, not a weak clone. It is listed because it is the one Higgs voice that needs nothing staged on disk, so it is what a machine can audition the serving stack with before any clone or fine-tune exists. Do not narrate a book in it expecting a particular narrator.
models._kindNote: kind default — THE SERVED MODEL'S OWN VOICE, and a distinct shape rather than an empty clips list. narrator refuses a ClipsVoice with zero clips, and it is right to: a zero-shot clone with NO reference is not a degenerate clone, it is a different thing entirely — the model's built-in speaker, which measures at 12% of the deathstalker narrator's ECAPA ceiling. An earlier draft of this catalog wrote `clips: []` for it and called that 'the served default voice', which made the two indistinguishable in the wire format and would have been refused by name.

models.label: Deathstalker (Higgs v3 fine-tune)
models._checkpointDirNote: NOT the /home/<user>/higgs-models/<voice>/ convention the installer creates, and the difference is load-bearing rather than cosmetic. THE CERTIFIED CAP IS BOUND TO THIS EXACT DIRECTORY: the 1200 below was measured by rendering against a vllm-omni started on /home/telltale/higgs_v3_merged/ds_ad4lm_prod, and that directory's own generation_config.json is what answered every request in the sweep. A copy staged somewhere else is a DIFFERENT DIRECTORY — nothing here, in narrator or in vllm-omni compares its weights or its generation_config.json byte for byte — so a copy would inherit the number without inheriting the measurement. THE DIRECTORY IS FROZEN: ds_ad4lm_prod is immutable, and any re-merge or recipe change writes a NEW directory name and is re-certified before it appears here (the training side's rule, 2026-09-05). HIGGS_MODELS_DIR in install_higgs_env.sh still describes where a voice MAY be staged; it is not where this one is, and moving this one would mean running the sweep again.
models._pendingNote: STAGED BUT NOT SERVED-CERTIFIED, AND REFUSED BY THE LOADER UNTIL IT IS. The merged checkpoint EXISTS at /home/telltale/higgs_v3_merged/ds_ad4lm_prod_ckpt1080 and carries the full required file set of a kind:'checkpoint' voice (model.safetensors 8.49 GB, config.json, tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json, chat_template.jinja, generation_config.json — see _checkpointFilesComment — plus merge_manifest.json naming lora runs/ds_ad4lm_prod/ckpt-1080 on base snapshot 239f63fb…). WHAT IS MISSING IS THE NUMBER: this directory's own length sweep has not been run, so maxChars is null and the voice is refused twice over — by this note and by refuseUnmeasuredAdapter. That is deliberate: ckpt-1080 replaced ckpt-480 as production on 2026-09-05 (lowest loss, chosen by ear), and the 1200 certified for ckpt-480 is bound to THAT directory, so carrying it across would be a cap nobody measured for these weights. The narration dropdown SHOWS this voice, greyed and unselectable, carrying this note: a voice everyone is waiting for should not silently be absent from the list. TO PROMOTE: run the sweep on THIS directory (method in _maxCharsNote), put the number and maxCharsSource 'length-sweep' in, and delete this note — nothing else is outstanding. ALSO STILL OWED, and not a blocker: no BookForge-side render has yet gone end to end against any Higgs checkpoint, and the MLX arm has no copy of this directory (a Mac render refuses at require_generation_config, correctly and by name, until it is staged there — and staging is a new certification, not an inheritance).

served._maxCharsNote: NULL, AND THE LOADER REFUSES THIS VOICE BECAUSE OF IT — not because nothing has ever been measured, but because THE CAP IS PER DIRECTORY and this directory's own sweep has not been run. The certified 1200 belongs to /home/telltale/higgs_v3_merged/ds_ad4lm_prod (ckpt-480) and DOES NOT TRANSFER to ds_ad4lm_prod_ckpt1080: different weights, different stop behaviour, and the certificate that produced 1200 names the directory it was measured against. Inheriting it here would be exactly the mistake this field exists to prevent, one directory further along. WHAT THE ckpt-480 SWEEP MEASURED, kept as the reference method rather than as this voice's answer: a length sweep at 600 / 900 / 1200 / 1500 characters, 4 SEEDS PER LENGTH, on the served path (vllm-omni started on that directory, with its generation_config.json in place), scored by ASR alignment and never by duration ratio; the certified cap is the largest length carrying ZERO babble across every seed AND >= 90 % coverage on EVERY seed, contiguous from the shortest; worst-seed coverage 600 → 98.5 %, 900 → 97.7 %, 1200 → 95.5 %, 1500 → 87.2 %, so 1500 stopped the ladder on COVERAGE and not on babble (babble was 0/16 at every length once the directory's generation_config.json restored top_k 50 — the babble class was untruncated sampling, not length). That is the method this directory's own sweep must repeat. WHY IT MAY NEVER BE GUESSED: a fine-tuned Higgs checkpoint's stop length tracks its TRAINING CLIP LENGTH rather than the text it is given — a 30-minute adapter trained on 8-22 s clips stopped after ~6-10 s of audio on any prompt over ~150 characters — so the zero-shot 600 is wrong for a fine-tune in the direction that LOSES TEXT while every duration check still looks plausible.
served._samplingNote: A MIRROR, AND THE DIRECTORY IS THE AUTHORITY. What answers every request is /home/telltale/higgs_v3_merged/ds_ad4lm_prod_ckpt1080/generation_config.json — vllm-omni resolves sampling from the MODEL DIRECTORY (--generation-config defaults to auto) and OpenAICreateSpeechRequest carries no sampling fields, so nothing per-request can correct it; narrator PROVES that file is there (v3_served.require_generation_config) and never writes one. Read on 2026-09-05 it holds {"temperature": 1.0, "top_p": 0.95, "top_k": 50, "repetition_penalty": 1.0, "_source": "stage-0 default_sampling_params from higgs_multimodal_qwen3.yaml"} — the same four numbers as the ckpt-480 directory, which is expected: both were written from the same recorded per-run override. The three are mirrored here so a reader can see what this voice samples at without opening a directory inside WSL, and tools/test-higgs-engine.js asserts the mirror still matches — a mirror nobody checks is how two copies of a number diverge. If they ever disagree, the DIRECTORY wins and this block is what is wrong.

models.note: The deathstalker narrator as a merged Higgs v3 fine-tune. WHY A FINE-TUNE RATHER THAN REFERENCE CLIPS: zero-shot cloning already recovers 92% of the narrator's speaker-identity ceiling (cosine 0.7037 of 0.7656, from a 27.4 s two-clip same-book reference), so TIMBRE is largely solved without training. What cloning does NOT recover is PHRASING — the render places 2.01 pauses per 100 chars against the narrator's 1.39 and runs pitch std 5.17 st against his 4.36, i.e. it performs the text rather than reading it, and no reference, sampling setting or control token moved either number. Only a fine-tune on his phrasing closes that gap, which is what this entry is for — and it is also why Owen ruled on 2026-09-04 that production narration is fine-tuned voices ONLY.
models._cloneFallbackNote: There is deliberately no clips-based deathstalker entry standing in for this one. The measured best zero-shot configuration is a 27.4 s join of cd_cd_00001100.wav + cd_cd_00001951.wav from the ds_ad4s cut with their book-exact transcripts, and it renders well — but those clips live under E:\training and are not a deployable artifact location, so an entry pointing at them would be a voice that works on exactly one machine, which is the failure this catalog exists to prevent. To add one: join the clips to a single wav (0.35 s of silence between them), join the transcripts in the same order, stage both under /home/<user>/higgs-models/<voice>/refs/, and declare ONE clip here with its measured `seconds`.
models._kindNote: kind 'checkpoint' — a MERGED fine-tune directory the server is started on, prompted TEXT-ONLY. No clips key: the voice is in the weights. It was called 'adapter' until 2026-09-04, which described the artifact we trained rather than the artifact that SERVES: vllm-omni has no runtime LoRA path, so the LoRA is an archival input to a merge and never a catalog field.

_pathComment: PATHS IN THIS FILE ARE HOST-NATIVE, and they are translated for the guest at DOCUMENT-WRITE time, per spawn arm (see higgsVoicesDocument). An earlier draft stored WSL-native paths and handed them to every arm untranslated, which is correct on the Windows+WSL arm by accident and meaningless on macOS/Linux, where there is no guest to be native to. `toGuestPath` translates a Windows drive path (C:... -> /mnt/c/...) and a \wsl$ UNC (the form tool-paths.ts already documents for orpheusModelsDir) and passes an already-guest-form path through unchanged, so a catalog written on any of the three machines resolves on all of them.
